snippet.title: Brave Escape - Xbox and PlayStation Release Date Trailer. 7/24.
snippet.description:
Brave Escape is a 2D pixel-art co-op platformer where teamwork is everything. Boost, rope, and coordinate your way through handcrafted levels designed entirely around two-player cooperation.

Purchase Brave Escape on Steam:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1354260/Brave_Escape/

Wishlist Brave Escape on XBOX Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/brave-escape/9pfh4lz8kw2z 

Wishlist Brave Escape on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10014973

Visit the Brave Escape website: https://hitstartstudios.com/games/brave-escape/

Follow Brave Escape on X: https://x.com/hitstartstudios

Follow Brave Escape on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/hitstartstudios/
